planted_defects.summary: The plan's 'Who I am' section is Barnum material — every sentence would be true of almost anyone
The plan claims Marcus finishes what he starts; his own notes list three abandoned novel drafts and a half-finished course, while what he demonstrably finishes is scoped technical work
Options A, B and C differ only in burn rate — all three rest on the single bet that his fiction produces income within about three years
The £40k debut advance and year-three writing income are asserted with no base rate and no publication record behind them
The claimed 18 months of runway is wrong on the plan's own budget: a £2,270/month shortfall against £21,400 savings is about nine months, less after the £6,000 earmarked for boiler and roof
Option C relocates the family for the 2027-28 academic year — the year of Maya's GCSEs — violating written ground rule 1
'Five years minimum, no wobbles, no exit ramps' — the plan names no observable sign of failure and forecloses the agreed six-month savings review
